questions.question: Explain the concept of Rationality in AI. What makes an agent rational?
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the concept of Rationality in AI. What makes an agent rational?
  • A rational agent is said to perform the right things . Rational agents are very
  • similar to intelligent agents. Rational agent is capable of taking best possible
  • action in any situation.
  • In artificial intelligence, rationality refers to an agent’s ability to choose actions
  • that maximize its performance measure, based on what it knows and perceives.
  • A rational agent is one that always tries to do the right thing —that is, take the
  • action expected to produce the best outcome given the situation.
  • Marks: Any answer with related meaning may be given marks.

  • Genetic Algorithms in achieving evolutionary optimization.

  • Crossover combines genetic information from two parent individuals to
  • produce offspring.

questions.question: List the differences between forward chaining and backward chaining.
questions.solution_html:
• List the differences between forward chaining and backward chaining.
  • Forward chaining is a data-driven approach that starts with known facts and
  • applies IF–THEN rules to generate new facts until a goal is reached; it moves
  • step by step from available information toward conclusions.
  • In backward chaining is a goal-driven approach that starts with a desired goal
  • and works backward by checking which rules could produce that goal, then
  • verifying whether their conditions are true (or can be proven).
  • Mark distribution : Forward chaining with diagram or example- (2 marks) , Backward
  • chaining with diagram or example- (2 marks) , Difference- (2 marks)
  • / [CO3]
